text:
grace: opened a draft PR to reconcile SOC2 wording for audit logs + SDK migration examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/678 (WIP). Need legal to confirm exact phrasing for tenant identifiers and retention.
ben: paste the current example so i can update the snippet quickly.
grace: current example in docs: 
```json
{"tenant_id": "org-99", "user_email": "pat@example.com", "action": "modify"}
```
kari: for SOC2 we should avoid showing raw tenant_id in examples. Suggest using tenant_hash and call out pseudonymization method + where the salt lives.
mara-legal: legal guidance: prefer explicit: 'Tenant identifiers in audit logs are pseudonymized via a salted cryptographic hash (e.g., HMAC-SHA256 with a secret salt). Mapping material, if retained, is access-restricted and access is audited.' Also ask to include retention default text and export encryption note.
grace: proposed text for doc: "Audit logs record tenant identifiers as tenant_hash values derived using a secret-salted HMAC-SHA256. Any mapping material is stored separately, access-restricted, and access to it is audited for security investigations. Audit exports are encrypted at rest. Default retention is 90 days; customers can configure export.retention_days." Thoughts?
ben: looks good. Add a one-line SDK migration snippet in JS and a short python example too. Also add a short FAQ: 'Why tenant_hash?' -> reduce PII in logs + easier compliance.
kari: tiny nit: use exact phrase 'audited access controls' in the sentence about mapping material.
mara-legal: change accepted. Also request we mention KMS/HSM for salt storage and recommend rotating the salt when rotating keys.
grace: added JS snippet to PR and noted KMS/HSM + rotation recommendation. JS snippet: 
```javascript
// compute tenantHash via HMAC-SHA256 with secret salt retrieved from KMS/HSM
const crypto = require('crypto');
const raw = 'tenant:acme';
const salt = await getSaltFromKms(); // retrieve salt from KMS/HSM
const hmac = crypto.createHmac('sha256', salt).update(raw).digest('hex');
await client.audit.logEvent({ tenantHash: hmac, actor: null, action: 'modify' });
// do not emit raw tenant identifiers in logs or exports
```
ben: link-checker reported one broken anchor in api-reference -> pushed a small nav fix. nav build preview is up: https://deploy.previews.redwood/678 (build passed).
kari: also include a tiny migration checklist item: 'Update SDK calls to tenantHash; review export filters; notify security team if you maintain mapping tables.'
mara-legal: LGTM with small edit: replace 'mapping material' with 'mapping tables or material' and keep 'audited access controls' phrase.
grace: updated PR per legal, added changelog entry under migration notes v2.1. CI green.
nav-bot: Auto-note: preview deploy created for PR 678.
ben: once legal signoff, i'll merge. Any outstanding blockers?
mara-legal: Approved. Please keep conservative phrasing.
grace: merging now. :shipit: I'll follow up with the FAQ blurb and a short note on enterprise migration support.
kari: thanks all. Closing thread.
ben: thanks!
